# MCS Auto Spray Painting

> Auto spray painting, body repair and interior workshop in Taman Bukit Indah, Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Signboard: Pusat Kecantikan Kereta.

- Address: No. 57, Jalan Indah 16/11, Taman Bukit Indah, 79000 Iskandar Puteri, Johor Darul Ta'zim, Malaysia
- WhatsApp and phone: +60 16-556 2998 (https://wa.me/60165562998)
- Email: mcs01092020@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon, Sat, Sun 9am to 7pm. Wed to Fri 9am to 5pm. Tuesday closed.
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/MCS+auto+spray+painting/@1.478931,103.6645659,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x31da7334a2c0c273:0x2e4dc3e240918966!8m2!3d1.478931!4d103.6645659!16s%2Fg%2F1hf239djx
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MCS99999 (Reels: https://www.facebook.com/MCS99999/reels)
